This is a {{< meta event.grading.credits >}}-credit 7 week course for graduate students. There are two lecure sessions with hands-on (80 minutes) and one hands-on lab (110 minutes) per week.
Nearly 60% of the time is hands-on. Anything that does not fit in class stays
as an at-home tutorial, so the open material is complete even when class time
is not. Dates, rooms and grading are in the official course information; this
page maps lessons to weeks.

<!-- The table is built from schedules/course-7week.yml and
schedules/modules.yml: move or re-time sessions there. -->
{{< schedule course-7week >}}

**Two projects.** In the hands-on parts of the lessons you build the LTEE
project; you hand in its GitHub repository and the Zenodo DOI of its release
after Week 7 ({{< meta event.grading.ltee-project >}}% of the grade, [what to hand in](assessment/ltee-project.qmd)).
From Week 2, the last 15 to 20 minutes of each lab apply that week's tool to
your capstone: your own research project, separate from the LTEE project (each
tutorial ends with *Apply it to your own project*; {{< meta event.grading.capstone >}}% of the grade, assessed
with the [rubric](assessment/capstone-rubric.qmd)).

**If a week runs long**, cut in this order: optional HPC steps, Jupyter, the
Conda comparison (already at home), the Nextflow introduction (shrink to a
demo). The packaging extra is always done at home.
